2608.20099.title: Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation for Efficient Multi-Agent Communication Topology Design
2608.20099.paper_summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by coordinating multiple agents, but at the cost of substantial token consumption. Recent work on automatic topology design, ARG-Designer, has reframed this problem as autoregressive graph generation. However, its training objective provides no explicit incentive for the model to generate sparse and efficient topologies. We address this limitation by introducing a Reward-Guided Autoregressive Graph Generation (RGA-Designer) inspired by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We train a reward model that jointly captures task correctness and structural compactness, and then fine-tune the pretrained graph generator using the reward model as feedback. Our method preserves task accuracy at the level of ARG-Designer while reducing token consumption by an average of 20.5%.
2608.20099.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於的多代理系統 (MAS) 通過協調多個代理在複雜推理任務上實現了強大的性能，但代價是大量的標記消耗。最近的自動拓撲設計工作，ARG-Designer，將這個問題重新定義為自回歸圖生成。然而，它的訓練目標並未為模型生成稀疏和高效的拓撲提供明確的激勵。我們通過引入一種受人類反饋強化學習 (RLHF) 啟發的獎勵引導自回歸圖生成 (RGA-Designer) 來解決這一限制。我們訓練一個獎勵模型，該模型共同捕捉任務正確性和結構緊湊性，然後使用獎勵模型作為反饋來微調預訓練的圖生成器。我們的方法在保持 ARG-Designer 任務準確性的同時，將標記消耗平均降低了 20.5%。
